name: Victor Ginelli
title: Founder and full-stack product engineer
profile: Founder and full-stack product engineer with 8+ years building payments, identity, mobile, and community products. Has led teams and taken complex systems from concept to production.

bullets: Led a passkey-secured virtual debit card from architecture through launch, spanning wallet ownership, identity checks, issuance, funding, authentication, lifecycle controls, webhooks, and durable workflows.
Designed activity scoring and token distribution that allocated 81M+ SEND, equal to 27% of the community allocation.
Helped move Send from a PWA to native apps on a shared TypeScript foundation, supporting 15 iOS releases, 1K+ Android downloads, 70K+ passkeys, and 20K Sendtags.
Moved payment execution to durable workflows for a platform with $53M+ in onchain transfer volume, covering confirmation, reconciliation, retries, activity updates, and notifications.
Shipped social payment features including group payments, conversational sends, public activity, reactions, transaction detail, and cross-platform notifications.
Built an athlete and fan platform for creating and livestreaming challenges, direct support, fan communities, and collectibles.
Created Dripp and $PANTS, a cross-community rewards campaign that extended operating runway by 12 months.
Paired Gitcoin fundraising with $PRTCLE incentives, contributing to a $100K+ community raise.
Led six recurring contributors and two contractors, and designed public governance and contribution rewards around measurable participation.
Took an identity-verification bot from hackathon prototype to a production service that verified 11,000+ people in one year.
Migrated deployment from Heroku to Railway and operated a dedicated BrightID node.
Shipped React, Solidity, payment, and identity improvements across SourceCred, Honeyswap, BrightID, and Colony.
